title: Diana Pasulka calls Chris Bledsoe a modern Paul Bennewitz
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Diana Pasulka calls Chris Bledsoe a modern Paul Bennewitz, about 2020s at North Carolina, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So uh but Dian Pasoka came out and she said I think Chris Bledsoe is a modern Paul Benowitz.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that a writer and researcher on UFO belief, Diana Pasulka, has publicly called Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had UFO encounters, a modern Paul Bennewitz. Bennewitz is a figure from an earlier chapter of UFO history whose story Michels discusses in the same episode, one titled around a man driven to madness by 'aliens'. The comparison suggests Bledsoe's experience may follow the same troubled pattern.
